thread:
maria: Quick experiment idea — split the weekly triage into two short slots next week: 25m morning backlog + 15m EOD bug sweep. Thoughts?
josh: sounds good. morning slot catches owners before standups. who's on morning/EOD?
anika: @maria if we do that, can we keep same owners but shift one person earlier? I can take morning Mon/Wed.
maria: Awesome. Can you own Mon/Wed morning? I'll take Tue/Thu morning. Friday we can rotate to oncall.
sam: I can do EOD sweep Mon/Tue. Prefer micro-agenda: quick triage, quick owner ping, and PR unblock.
leo: SGTM. Can we add a 'blockers' sticky? like top-3 list we read out.
infra-bot: Reminder: morning slot should not exceed 30m to avoid blocking daily standups. :robot_face:
anika: proposed abbreviated agendas: 
``` 
Morning (25m):
- Quick backlog triage (10m)
- Owner assignment / PR pings (10m)
- Quick escalations (5m)

EOD (15m):
- Bug queue sweep (10m)
- Ownership confirmations (5m)
```
maria: Perfect. I'll update calendar invites: new slots M-F 09:10-09:35 and 16:45-17:00. Does that conflict with anyone?
josh: 09:10 is fine for me, 16:45 sometimes overlaps w/ customer sync Wed. can we make Friday EOD 16:15-16:30 as exception?
maria: Yep, we can do flex Friday. Will add note.
sam: one more ask: add a thread in the triage channel to capture actions from EOD so async folks can follow. I'll create a pinned 'daily triage notes' doc.
leo: :thumbsup: Also add a tag format for owner pings: `@owner — reason — PR/issue`
anika: I'll take Mon morning owner pair with @josh for initial two weeks.
maria: Thanks all. Quick poll: do we want to trial for 2 weeks or 4 weeks?
josh: 2 weeks then review metrics (avg time to assign owner, queue drain).
sam: 2w ok.
leo: 2w.
maria: Cool. I'll push invites and a short agenda template to the channel. tagging owners: @anika @sam @leo for first run. infra-bot, please remind team 1h before morning slot.
infra-bot: Acknowledged. Will send reminders 1h and 10m before slots for the next 14 days.
sre-watch: Noted — will monitor error/throughput alerts during morning slot.
maria: Thanks — closing this thread. Please drop conflicts ASAP.
